title: 3-Hydroxy-beta-ionone Suppresses Breast Cancer Progression by Inducing Apoptosis and Blocking EMT Through the TGF-beta/Smad Signaling Pathway.
authors: Sutana, Pornsuda; Luetragoon, Thitiya; Buakaew, Watunyoo; Daotak, Krai; Nilsri, Nungruthai; Thongsri, Yordhathai; Potup, Pachuen; Leon, Catherine; Usuwanthim, Kanchana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究3-HBI通过TGF-beta/Smad通路诱导凋亡和抑制EMT的抗乳腺癌作用，虽用分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is the most aggressive breast cancer subtype, with limited treatment options and a poor prognosis. Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) plays a critical role in promoting TNBC metastasis. The natural bioactive substance 3-hydroxy-beta-ionone (3-HBI), which has been studied in other cancer types, has not yet been examined in TNBC. This study investigates its potential mechanisms in TNBC cells through a combination of computational and experimental approaches, focusing on apoptosis induction and EMT inhibition. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated strong and stable binding of 3-HBI to key apoptosis-related proteins (Bcl-2, Bax, caspase-3) and EMT regulators (Smad2, Smad3). In vitro, 3-HBI significantly reduced cell viability in MDA-MB-231, T47D, and MCF7 cells, with IC(50) values of 388.40, 185.50, and 113.40 microg/mL, respectively. Moreover, 3-HBI suppressed clonogenic potential, induced apoptosis, and inhibited both migration and invasion. Molecular analysis showed increased expression of Bax, caspase-3, and E-cadherin, and reduced levels of Bcl-2, Smad2, Smad3, and N-cadherin. These findings provide the first mechanistic evidence that 3-HBI exerts anti-TNBC effects by promoting apoptosis and suppressing EMT, highlighting its potential as a promising therapeutic candidate for TNBC treatment.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是最具侵袭性的乳腺癌亚型，治疗选择有限且预后不良。上皮-间质转化（EMT）在促进TNBC转移中发挥关键作用。天然生物活性物质3-羟基-β-紫罗兰酮（3-HBI）已在其他癌症类型中有所研究，但在TNBC中尚未被探讨。本研究通过计算与实验相结合的方法，探讨其在TNBC细胞中的潜在机制，重点关注凋亡诱导和EMT抑制。分子对接和分子动力学模拟表明，3-HBI与关键凋亡相关蛋白（Bcl-2、Bax、caspase-3）及EMT调控因子（Smad2、Smad3）具有强且稳定的结合。在体外实验中，3-HBI显著降低MDA-MB-231、T47D和MCF7细胞的活力，其IC(50)值分别为388.40、185.50和113.40微克/毫升。此外，3-HBI抑制克隆形成能力，诱导凋亡，并抑制迁移和侵袭。分子分析显示，Bax、caspase-3和E-cadherin表达增加，而Bcl-2、Smad2、Smad3和N-cadherin水平降低。这些发现首次提供了机制性证据，表明3-HBI通过促进凋亡和抑制EMT发挥抗TNBC作用，凸显其作为TNBC治疗有前景候选药物的潜力。
